description: This is a line chart titled "Figure 3a Orography Factor O for hills and ridges". The vertical axis is marked from 1.00 at the base to 1.40 at the top, in steps of 0.05. The horizontal axis is labelled "x/Lu" and runs from -1 to 2.5. Three curves rise from the left, peak at x/Lu = 0, then fall to the right. The uppermost curve peaks at 1.35 and is labelled "Steep slope < 1/3.3". The middle curve peaks at 1.20 and is labelled "Moderate slope = 1/5". The lowest curve peaks at 1.10 and is labelled "Shallow slope ≤ 1/10". In the top-right corner is an inset line drawing of a hill profile with a horizontal shaded band across its crest, labelled "Orography significant in shaded area". The inset carries the dimensions "z", "0.5z", "Lu", "1.5Lu", and the offsets "-X" and "+X". The vertical axis title on the far left is partly cut off and not fully legible.
